snippet.title: My Truck Game - Trailer 1
snippet.description:
►My Truck Game Steam Early Access: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1763830/My_Truck_Game/
►Demo: https://www.mytruckgame.com/2020/01/my-truck-game-demo.html 
►My Truck Game Website: https://www.mytruckgame.com/

► About My Truck Game:

This game is focused on physics based off road truck and bus simulation. The main priority is tire deformation and suspension simulation.
At the moment there are no missions in the game, just go to a garage, choose the vehicle that you like, drive it around and explore the 3 maps available.

►GENRE: Simulation, Early Access
►RELEASE DATE: 7 Feb, 2022
